description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of the PolicyEntry interface, with methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, and for serializing to JSON.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyEntry
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the PolicyEntry interface, representing a policy entry with label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyEntry instance with specified label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyEntry from a JSON object, extracting fields and handling exceptions.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the subjects of the policy entry.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns the resources of the policy entry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the policy entry to a JSON object with schema version and an optional predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality of this PolicyEntry with another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
